description: Apply a recipe of operations to a PDF in one call, charged once however many it carries: text.add, watermark.text, watermark.image, header_footer, bates.stamp, pages.rotate/delete/extract/reorder/insert, metadata.set/strip, sanitize, form.fill, form.flatten, annotate.highlight/note/stamp, annotations.flatten. Call inspect_pdf with for_edit first for page ids and form fields. Docs: https://apidocs.podpdf.com/api-reference/pdf-editor

file.description: A PDF: a path on this machine, e.g. "./contract.pdf", or an https:// link to one

recipe.description: Operations applied in order, e.g. [{"op":"watermark.text","text":"DRAFT","rotation":45},{"op":"metadata.strip"}]. For `pages`, use page ids from inspect_pdf as a list (["p0","p2"]) or page numbers as a range string ("1-3,5").

save_path.description: Optional local file path to save the PDF to, e.g. "./invoice.pdf". The download link is returned either way.

name: edit_pdf
title: Edit PDF
